# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.12.2** (published 2026-10-18, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.12.1** (`291e0558`; native Windows `C:` path fix #15511 and two `omp -p` false-success exit fixes #15732, #15897).
- **RTX 5090 container lane:** Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2 on loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`
  (local Windows client or manual macOS SSH tunnel preview); `v0.6.16-qwen38-5090-beta.1`, profile
  `qwen38-5090-v0.11.0`, model `0634abb0` (20.4 GB), DFlash2 draft window 7, BF16 KV,
  131,072-token context, two requests in flight, vision + tools.
- **RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows 11 lanes:** `v0.6.11-qwen38-4090-beta.1` and
  `v0.6.3-qwen38-3090-beta.1` on loopback `127.0.0.1:18082`, UUID-bound on one two-GPU host
  (sequential single-GPU serving, one lane at a time), model `eec39564` (18.2 GB), MTP3, INT8 KV,
  131,072-token context, one request at a time, text + tools (no vision).
- **Proof:** Fresh v0.12.2 acceptance on frozen candidate `d7ed4a65` across five documented routes
  (31 steps), three stock Oh My Pi 18.12.1 clients (macOS arm64 preview, Windows x64, Linux x64
  under WSL2), and both native Windows public installs (owner-operated); runtime qualifications
  carry unchanged from v0.12.0 and v0.11.0.

## Release authorities (v0.12.2)

- [v0.12.2 manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.12.2/releases/v0.12.2/manifest.json): exact client, runtime, model, and profile pins
- [v0.12.2 release notes](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.12.2/releases/v0.12.2/NINFER_RELEASE_NOTES.md): release scope, client SHA-256 digests, acceptance, and support boundaries
- [v0.12.2 tagged quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.12.2/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable installation guide for v0.12.2

## Living canonical documents

- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): trust boundary, loopback invariants, key handling, and verification
